en.shortDescription: Professional publishing platform for blogs and newsletters
en.longDescription:
Ghost is a modern publishing platform for professional bloggers, journalists, and newsletter creators.

Includes MariaDB. Set url via SERVICE_URL_GHOST for correct links and assets. Complete the setup wizard on first launch.

de.shortDescription: Professionelle Publishing-Plattform für Blogs und Newsletter
de.longDescription:
Ghost ist eine moderne Publishing-Plattform für professionelle Blogger, Journalisten und Newsletter-Autoren.

Enthält MariaDB. Setze url über SERVICE_URL_GHOST für korrekte Links und Assets. Schließe den Einrichtungsassistenten beim ersten Start ab.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme de publication professionnelle pour blogs et newsletters

Ghost est une plateforme de publication moderne pour les blogueurs, journalistes et créateurs de newsletters professionnels.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma profissional de publicação para blogs e newsletters
pt.longDescription:
Ghost é uma plataforma de publicação moderna para blogueiros, jornalistas e criadores de newsletters profissionais.
